How this is calculated

68 / 688 covered checkpoints / all registered evidence checkpoints (86 rows × 8 stages). Mapping, reference, rules, playable, integration, save/retry recovery, original-level acceptance and physical play each count once per row. Only covered earns credit; partial/open earn zero. Global across filters. Register evidence completion, not game completion, parity, effort or test-pass percentage. 100% requires every checkpoint covered; near-complete values are capped at 99.9%.

original

Load exact local Training43, apply four selected source-verified actors, start and follow supported dry routes.

Dry directional stairs only.

Load ready Training43 team, then Selected-team dry-fall practice.

Source-bound stats/weight on authored ledges; authored incapacitation.

Relocated ground cache

Pickup/drop ownership; original item placement not installed.

Load ready-to-play Training43; F fires, T changes designated hit/miss, Esc pauses.

authored

Static gate practice

Set up keyboard gate practice; C activates the facing panel.

Button/collision and replay in authored arena.

Patrol extraction challenge

Start authored patrol extraction; C opens, F defeats designated target, extract all four.

Authored route and objective, no original AI/enemy attacks.

Start timed door challenge; C requests movement, wait for WALK THROUGH, defeat target and extract.

How this register is maintained

Primary behavioural reference is the older OCS patched source, with exact local OCS roster/items. Editor maps are individually digest-pinned; no retail authentication, whole-startup, runtime-map or wall-clock parity is implied. CD32 differences stay explicit.

The JSON is the source of truth. The HTML and Markdown checklist are generated from it. There is no live status polling or automatic acceptance upgrade.

  1. Add or split a mechanic when a source branch, item category, species or interaction is discovered. Keep stable IDs.
  2. Define original behaviour and revision, with exact scope and remaining unknowns. Name adaptations explicitly.
  3. Link reference evidence, rules tests, browser scenarios, integration tests and recovery cases. Record run receipts separately from file presence.
  4. Audit each original level’s active callers and targets; promote present-unverified to required/reachable-optional only with level-specific evidence.
  5. Update reviewed head/date after reconciling accepted changes. Rebuild and check all links before publishing a new assessment.
  6. Close acceptance only with a reviewed receipt containing exact build/source identities, test commands/results/skips and physical observations.

Register tooling

Maintenance notes · Level inventory tool · Register validation tests · Browser verification

Commands

Rebuild index and Markdownnpx tsx tools/build-mechanics-register.ts

Validate links/IDs and regenerate this self-contained HTML and text checklist from register.json.

Check index freshnessnpx tsx tools/build-mechanics-register.ts --check

Fails when generated pages differ from the current register.

Rules, lint, types and buildnpm run check

Existing automated suite; passing is limited to implemented/tested behaviours.

Browser scenariosnpm run test:browser

Original-resource scenarios require explicit local configuration and may otherwise skip.

Repeat private editor inventorynpx tsx tools/audit-mechanics-levels.ts <archive-root> <catalogue.json> .local/mechanics-register/new-inventory.json

47-map static flags/sentinels with digest verification. Inspect differences before updating the register; never upgrades acceptance automatically.

Known limits

  • Status is a dated assessment of accepted main through PR111, not live CI telemetry. The player-only authored pressure pad is accepted; broader original callers remain open.
  • Covered means the row’s stated slice is covered, not that every original branch or interaction is proven. Read mapping scope and gaps.
  • A linked test is a traceable test file, not a fresh passing run. Original-dependent tests may skip without local resources; public CI uses synthetic data.
  • Static editor observations do not prove runtime activation, target validity, reachability, required puzzle roles or completed gameplay.
  • Zero complete original levels are accepted. No whole-game completion percentage is calculated.
  • Original archives, assembly, maps, routes and raw traces remain local/ignored. This page contains summaries and links, not original content.

Required acceptance receipt

A future pass must name the mechanic or level, original revision/digests, accepted build commit, scenario, expected/observed outcomes, test command and pass/fail/skip totals, recovery replay, reviewer and any physical hardware/human observations. Original data and traces stay private. This initial register does not contain such a whole-level pass.
